charts.title: TOI-5300 b: orbits around TOI-5300
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5300's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5300 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Frensch et al. 2025 (2025A&A...700A.118F), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname FRENSCH_ET_AL_2025): P 2.262196 d

charts.title: TOI-5300 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5300 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (70, 92) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 267215820, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 6 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 6 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 6 min late; 9-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 2 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
